minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  January 28, 2020

The Successor Agency of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on
Tuesday, January 28, 2020, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

Mayor Butts called the City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency for
Closed Session at the hour of 1:03 p.m.
The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary announced the presence of a quorum as
follows:
  Present:  Mayor/Chairman Butts, Council Members/Successor
  Agency Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales and Franklin;
  and
  Absent:  None.
City/Successor Agency officials and personnel present for closed session were as
follows:

  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

PUBLIC  COMMENTS  REGARDING  CLOSED  SESSION  ITEMS.
Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons present who
wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency on the Closed Session Items.

There was no response.

Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman Butts recessed the City Council/Successor Agency at
the hour of 1:03 p.m. for Closed Session Item Nos. CS-1- CS-5 and CSA-1.

  *****************

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, Finance
Authority, Parking Authority, and Joint Powers Authority at the hour of 2:00 p.m.
The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary/Finance
Authority Secretary/Parking Authority Secretary/Joint Powers Authority Secretary
announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman/Finance Authority Chairman/Parking Authority
  Chairman/Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts,
  Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing
  Authority Members/Finance Authority Members/Parking
  Authority Members/Joint Powers Authority Members
  Padilla, Morales, and Franklin; and
  Absent:  Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing
  Authority Member/Finance Authority Member/Parking
  Authority Member/Joint Powers Authority Member
  Dotson.

City/Successor Agency / Housing Authority / Finance Authority / Parking Authority
/Joint Powers Authority officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  David Esparza  Asst. City Manager/CFO
  Cheryl Moore  Management Assistant

  1
 January 28, 2020

  * Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, Finance Authority,
  Parking Authority, and Joint Powers Authority.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.  Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman/Finance Authority Chairman/Parking Authority
  Chairman/Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons
  present who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing
  Authority/Finance Authority/Parking Authority/Joint Powers Authority on any item on
  the Agenda.

  There was no response.

 142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Council Member
  /Successor Agency Member / Housing Authority Member Franklin, and seconded by
  Council Member /Successor Agency Member / Housing Authority Member Morales that
  the demands presented to the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority dated
  January 17, 2020, in the amount of $5,697,478.10, and January 23, 2020, in the amount
  of $1,651,705.04 are hereby allowed, and the City Clerk/Successor Agency
  Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary is hereby authorized to certify upon said registers
  that said demands are so approved. The motion was carried by the following roll call
  vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority
  Member Dotson.

 132.6  CLOSED SESSION – CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL; NAME OF
  CASE: MSG FORUM, LLC V. OVERSIGHT BOARD TO THE SUCCESSOR
  AGENCY TO THE INGLEWOOD REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY, ET AL;
  LACSC CASE NO. BS174710. Closed session – Confidential – Attorney/Client
  Privileged; Conference with Legal Counsel regarding Pending Litigation Pursuant to
  Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(1); Name of Case: MSG Forum, LLC v. Oversight
  Board to the Successor Agency to the Inglewood Redevelopment Agency, et al; LACSC
  Case No. BS174710.

  Direction given to staff.

  SUCCESSOR AGENCY MINUTES. It was moved by Successor Agency Member
  Morales, and seconded by Successor Agency Member Franklin that the Minutes for the
  Successor Agency Meetings held on January 14, 2020, be approved. The motion was
  carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Successor Agency Members Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Successor Agency
  Chairman Butts; and
  Noes:  None; and
  Absent: Successor Agency Member Dotson.

 219  SUCCESSOR AGENCY TREASURER – MONTHLY TREASURER’S REPORT.
  Staff report dated January 28, 2020, was presented submitting the Monthly Treasurer’s
  Report for the Month ending October 31, 2019.

  Successor Agency Chairman Butts ordered the report received and filed.

 101  AGREEMENT NO. 20-117 APPROVED – BHAGAT INVESTMENTS CENTURY,
  LLC.; USE OF TAX-EXEMPT BONDS APPROVED. Staff report dated January 28,
  2020, was presented recommending approval of a Purchase and Sale Agreement with
  Bhagat Investments Century, LLC, to secure a 695 square feet right of way from the
  larger parcel located at 3940 W. Century Boulevard, needed to implement the Century
  Boulevard Mobility Improvement Project, subarea 3.

  2
 January 28, 2020

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Franklin
  that the City Council does hereby approve Agreement No. 20-117 with Bhagat
  Investments Century, LLC. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Member Dotson.

  It was moved by Successor Agency Member Morales and seconded by Council Member
  Franklin that the Successor Agency does hereby approve the use of tax-exempt bonds in
  the amount of $127,200 to fund the purchase of the property. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Successor Agency Members Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Successor
  Agency Chairman Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Successor Agency Member Dotson.

 125  AMENDMENT NO. 3 TO AGREEMENT NO. 18-118 APPROVED – MILLER
  BARONDESS, LLP. Staff report dated January 28, 2020, was presented recommending
  approval of Amendment No. 3 to Agreement No. 18-118 with Miller Barondess, LLP for
  broad ranging legal advice, guidance and representation to establish two rate tiers
  depending on the legal matter for which legal services are provided.

  It was moved by Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Parking Authority
  Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Parking
  Authority Member Franklin that the City Council/Successor Agency/Parking Authority
  does hereby approve Amendment No. 3 to Agreement No. 18-118 with Miller Barondess,
  LLP. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Parking Authority Members
  Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Parking
  Authority Chairman Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Parking Authority Member
  Dotson.

  There being no further business to be presented, Chairman Butts declared the meeting
  adjourned in memory of Kobe Bryant, Gianna Bryant, and the other persons aboard the
  helicopter who lost their lives in the tragedy, as well as Arrick “Dobby” Turner and
  Yvonne Honoree, Mother in Law of Dennis Smith at the hour of 2:37 p.m.

  Approved this 11th day of February, 2020

  _________________________
  Yvonne Horton, Secretary

  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Chairman
